name: Trade Data 16
definition: Provides information on the status of a trade.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique system identification assigned to the trade by the central matching system.

MatchingSystemMatchingReference.name: Matching System Matching Reference
MatchingSystemMatchingReference.definition: Reference to the unique matching identification assigned to the trade and to the matching trade from the counterparty by the central matching system.

MatchingSystemMatchedSideReference.name: Matching System Matched Side Reference
MatchingSystemMatchedSideReference.definition: Unique reference from the central settlement system that allows the removal of alleged trades once the matched status notification for the matching side has been received.

StatusOriginator.name: Status Originator
StatusOriginator.definition: Party that assigned the status to the trade.

CurrentStatus.name: Current Status
CurrentStatus.definition: Specifies the new status of a trade.

CurrentStatusSubType.name: Current Status Sub Type
CurrentStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the current status of a trade in a central system.

CurrentStatusDateTime.name: Current Status Date Time
CurrentStatusDateTime.definition: Specifies the date and time at which the current status was assigned.

PreviousStatus.name: Previous Status
PreviousStatus.definition: Specifies the previous status of a trade.

PreviousStatusSubType.name: Previous Status Sub Type
PreviousStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the previous status of a trade in a central system.
